verdicts.reason: A is just the original shrunk into the left half: the right ~45% of the banner is empty grey, the text is small, and the layout is badly lopsided. Still, the red panel, quote, attribution and skyline keep their original relationships. B fills the canvas but breaks the design: a decorative line cuts through 'MODERN' in the headline, the bottom half of the red panel is empty, the attribution floats off to the side, and the skyline becomes a small separate thumbnail in a white box, so the signature skyline-over-panel image is lost.
